title: The Works: orders and power numbers fixed
lines: A side order's card stays on that order when another order is swapped or handed over.
A machine's card, the power book, the power bar and the Trouble list agree on what a machine makes and the power it draws.

more.head: Fixed
points: A machine where power does not reach shows 0 /min on its card.
The Items list stops counting a machine once you take it away. A machine built in its place counts once it starts making something.
The power book says what one machine draws at its grade. Mills of grades I and II show 3 to 4.5 each.
When power is short, the power book, the power bar and the Trouble list show the same speed.
A belt laid with two taps from the tile in front of a mill or boiler into it is one belt, not three around the corner.
Dragging the map and touching it with a second finger no longer closes the map and moves the view.
Holding a finger on the yard no longer opens a card after the browser has taken the touch away.
